properties.name: Thickness
properties.description: Wall thickness. 0 builds the air space as a solid body instead of a hollow shell

properties.name: LossCoefficient
properties.description: Pressure-loss coefficient K, referenced to the connecting duct's own velocity (nominal open-position value; damper modulation is not modeled)

properties.name: DamperType
properties.description: How the loss is found. Coefficient uses LossCoefficient as given; any other choice reads the loss of that kind of damper at its current position

properties.name: BladeAngle
properties.description: Blade angle from fully open (0 = fully open)

properties.name: GateOpening
properties.description: Gate damper only: open height as a fraction of the duct height (1 = fully open)

properties.name: BladeCount
properties.description: Multi-blade dampers only: number of blades
